title: Evolving Spiking Lineage Cards
summary: Sort cautious paper cards and complete a source-boundary check for the active eSNN bundle, moving from thesis-taxonomy vocabulary through lineage, application, method-placeholder, adaptive-structure, and structural-plasticity bridge roles without overclaiming unreviewed algorithm details.
learning_goals: Separate reviewed eSNN lineage context from pending exact growth-rule details.
Connect Schliebs2013, Wysoski2010, Kasabov2013, Wang2014, and the shared Roy2017 bridge to the thesis taxonomy without duplicating paper records.
Use bundle readiness notes to decide which claims are safe for public teaching artifacts.
Reject source-boundary claims that turn metadata, titles, or thesis vocabulary into verified method mechanics.
